summary: All five UI-pass requirements are implemented correctly and verified: data-driven in-topic jump + strength filter bar, per-argument Copy/Link with aria-live and clipboard fallback, OG/Twitter meta, PWA (manifest + pinned vite-plugin-pwa@0.21.1 + service worker/icons in dist/), and a class-based light/dark theme with an accessible NavBar toggle and no-flash bootstrap. npm run typecheck and npm run build both exit 0; the ink/parchment/gold + Cormorant/Inter aesthetic, the 'Ave Christus Rex' brand, the data/research files, and the 0.0.0.0:5317 strictPort server/preview config are all intact.
